newsitem.title: USA: NBA star Iverson charged with drug, gun possession.
newsitem.headline: NBA star Iverson charged with drug, gun possession.

text.p: Basketball star Allen Iverson was arrested on drug and gun charges after a car in which he was a passenger was pulled over for speeding, authorities said on Monday.
Iverson was riding in the front passenger seat when the Mercedes Benz was stopped by a state trooper on Interstate 64 in New Kent County early Sunday, Virginia State Police Lt. Len Terry said.
The trooper smelled marijuana smoke and subsequently found a .45-calibre handgun on the floor and marijuana cigarettes in the front and back seats, Terry said.
"Mr. Iverson admitted to ownership of the weapon and was charged," he said.
Iverson, the top choice in the National Basketball Association's college draft, led the Philadelphia 76ers in scoring last season and won the NBA rookie-of-the-year award.
He was charged with possession of marijuana and possession of a weapon, Terry said.
The driver, Maduro Hill, 32, of Hampton, Va., was charged with reckless driving, Terry said. The other passenger, Damon Stewart, 25, also of Hampton, was charged with possession of marijuana.
